title: Outdoor Wood Deck with Pergola and Seating
description: Designer outdoor seating area featuring natural wood deck, solid wood pergola, built-in benches, and ambient lighting for the garden
longDescription: Perfect outdoor space combining functionality with stunning design. The project includes a quality wood deck with weather-resistant parquet, solid wood pergola creating natural shade and privacy, designer benches with comfortable backrests built into the deck, and ambient lighting completing the romantic atmosphere. The space is designed for enjoying quality outdoor time, family meals, or hosting guests in a natural and inviting environment.
